about: Table props for the 3D scene, made from generated GLB files with tools/prop-glb.ts. The sources and the results are media and lie outside Git under assets/props/; this file names each source by its SHA-256 and says how it is made fit for the scene.

source.provenance: Generated by Jakob in Meshy AI on 2026-11-11 (image to 3D with texture) and handed over in C:/Users/jakem/Desktop/glb. The shoe was made from a frame of the film's own shoe (sko-ur-filmen.png).

props.note: The mouth points to +Z in the source, as the scene wants it. 191 672 triangles and 4K textures in the source.
Twelve tubes with the chips modelled in; the requirement was an empty tray. 3 849 960 triangles in the source.

notUsed.original: black-jack-tbl.glb (the same file as the two Meshy_AI_Blackjack_Table_Model files)
notUsed.note: A whole table with its own felt print, five bet spots, a tray and a shoe modelled in; 937 290 triangles. Not converted: what it is for is Jakob's to say.
